gaps.sentence: The hotel offered ___ our room free of charge.
gaps.explanation: offer takes the to-infinitive: offered to upgrade.

gaps.sentence: You risk ___ your licence if you drink and drive.
She made her son ___ his room before dinner.
gaps.explanation: make + object + bare infinitive: made him tidy (passive takes to: was made to tidy).

gaps.sentence: I could hear the neighbours ___ again last night.
gaps.explanation: hear + object + -ing = hear an action in progress: hear them arguing.

gaps.sentence: I regret ___ you that the flight has been cancelled.
gaps.explanation: regret + to-infinitive (formal announcements); regret + -ing = be sorry about the past.
seem/appear take the to-infinitive: seems to know.

gaps.sentence: I've always wanted ___ how to sail.
He continued ___ as if nothing had happened.
gaps.explanation: continue takes -ing or to-infinitive. Both accepted.
